verdict.rationale: Stripe does perform fiat↔stablecoin conversion in practice (onramp purchases, stablecoin payments settling to fiat balance, stablecoin payouts converting fiat to USDC) and documents that conversion happens, but there is no evidence of a dedicated 'quote' API, explicit conversion rate documentation, or settlement-time SLAs; community comments even note unclear/variable delays and fees when de-tokenizing USDC back to fiat. Missing for 10: a documented quotes/exchange-rate endpoint, explicit fee schedule for conversions, documented settlement-time guarantees, and stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion support.
